description: This Dart source file defines the HomePage widget for a Flutter mobile application. It provides a user interface for controlling audio input sources, amplification, noise reduction, equalizer presets, and media playback. The widget interacts with services for audio processing and application settings, updating UI components based on user interactions.

classes.name: HomePage
classes.description: A stateless widget that builds the main interface for audio control, including input source selection, amplification, noise reduction, equalizer presets, and media playback.

methods.name: _eqLabel
methods.description: Returns a string label for a given equalizer preset.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree representing the home page UI with various audio controls.
